questions.question: For which parts of the Helsingborg Dresser's drawers does the other supplier quote a shorter lead time than the preferred supplier?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.part_name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping pref ON pref.part_id = c.part_id AND pref.preferred_supplier JOIN part_supplier_mapping other ON other.part_id = c.part_id AND NOT other.preferred_supplier WHERE p.product_name = 'Helsingborg Dresser' AND a.component_name = 'Drawers' AND other.lead_time_days < pref.lead_time_days
questions.note: Every part has exactly two suppliers, one of them preferred.

questions.question: Which suppliers provide the parts of the Linköping Bed's headboard?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Linköping Bed' AND a.component_name = 'Headboard'

questions.question: Which products contain a part supplied by German Precision Fasteners?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id WHERE m.supplier_id = 'SUP-004'

questions.question: In which countries are the suppliers of the Uppsala Sofa's seat cushion parts based?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.country FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Uppsala Sofa' AND a.component_name = 'Seat Cushion'

questions.question: Which suppliers supply parts to both the Malmö Desk and the Helsingborg Dresser?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE p.product_name IN ('Malmö Desk', 'Helsingborg Dresser') GROUP BY s.name HAVING count(DISTINCT p.product_name) = 2

questions.question: How many different suppliers provide parts of the Stockholm Chair?
questions.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT m.supplier_id) FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Stockholm Chair'
questions.note: Parts of the seat and the back rest.
